Container.Name: TypeBitTorrent
Container.Overview:
TypeBitTorrent is a BitTorrent client built on the TypeBit Rust engine (a Windows desktop client and an Android app ship from the same code base). This container runs the head-less build and serves the built-in WebUI, so the whole client — transfers, per-file priorities, renames, trackers, peers, settings, engine statistics, search, RSS and torrent creation — is usable from a browser on your LAN. Downloads are written straight to the array; nothing is proxied.
Set a WebUI password in the template before starting: the server never exposes an unauthenticated interface to the network.
Note: the release repository is licensed under PolyForm Perimeter 1.0.0 (source-available, not OSI-approved), which is why this template is distributed here for manual/compose installation rather than through the Community Applications feed.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: torrent bittorrent client nas webui dht
Container.Requires: Docker image ghcr.io/blueokanna/typebittorrent (or a local build via packaging/docker).
Container.Changes: Initial release: head-less engine + WebUI, per-file priorities, tracker editing, live peers, RSS, search and torrent creation.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: WebUI 端口（浏览器访问 http://[IP]:[PORT:18881]）

Config.Name: Peer port (TCP)
Config.Description: BitTorrent 监听端口（入站连接）。若被 ISP 封禁可在设置里改成别的端口。

Config.Name: Peer port (UDP)
Config.Description: DHT / uTP / SSR 使用的 UDP 端口

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: 设置、续传数据与回执（必须持久化）

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: 下载与做种目录（WebUI 中把默认保存目录设为 /downloads）

Config.Name: WebUI 密码
Config.Description: WebUI 登录密码（至少 8 位，必填）

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: 文件属主 UID（Unraid 默认 99 = nobody）

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: 文件属组 GID（Unraid 默认 100 = users）
